in_hebrew.name: Hindorff
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Ruler of the forest
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Hindorff הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old High German word 'hint' meaning 'heath' and 'dorf' meaning 'village' or 'settlement'. This name may have been given to a person who lived near or ruled over a forested area.

in_greek.name: Hindorff
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Ruler of the forest
in_greek.long_meaning: Hindorff είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Old High German word 'hint' meaning 'heath' and 'dorf' meaning 'village' or 'settlement'. This name may have been given to a person who lived near or ruled over a forested area.

in_latin.name: Hindorff
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Ruler of the forest
in_latin.long_meaning: Hindorff est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Old High German word 'hint' meaning 'heath' and 'dorf' meaning 'village' or 'settlement'. This name may have been given to a person who lived near or ruled over a forested area.
